findings.title: profiles was row-scoped but not COLUMN-scoped over PostgREST: any authenticated user could PATCH their own row's role/account_type and mint themselves an admin
findings.fix: SHIPPED: db/migrations/0211_profiles_lock_postgrest_writes.sql drops the policy outright - profiles keeps its SELECT policy and has no PostgREST write surface, mirroring what 0163 did for ownerships. A column-level REVOKE was rejected because applySchemaGrants (scripts/deploy-provision.ts:533-541) re-grants ALL on every provision.
findings.origin: healthy-claim refutation in lens A01 (see lenses/A01.md:57 for the recipe and :58 for the closure note). Id assigned by this synthesis, not by the lens; R = refuter-originated. It carries no severity in A01's own verdict line for that reason.
findings.refuterVote: 5/5 confirmed. Escalated from 3 refuters to 5 per the plan's CRITICAL rule. Vote of record: engram topic sdd/audit-2026-09/decisions; re-refutation workflow runId wf_8bd36c20-bc1.
findings.mechanism: The policy 'Profiles updatable by self' (migration 0086, altered by 0137) pinned the ROW in both USING and WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid()) and never a COLUMN. No column GRANT/REVOKE existed on profiles; no BEFORE UPDATE trigger compared old.role/new.role; the account_type/role pairing CHECK was dropped in migration 0016; supabase/config.toml:13 exposes the public schema over PostgREST. The authorization layer reads profiles.role/account_type/deactivated_at (lib/infra/request-cache.ts getProfileCached, lib/infra/auth-guards.ts loadActiveInstitutionalProfile) and never consults the JWT.
findings.guardBlindTo: scripts/check-authz-guards.ts findImpersonationExports (:818, file unchanged between the audited SHA and HEAD) reads 'use server' exports only and cannot see PostgREST; __tests__/rls/write-path-matrix.test.ts:20-31 classifies an auth.uid()-scoped policy as SAFE (true of rows, false of columns); __tests__/rls/matrix.test.ts:64 sets OPERATIONS_UNDER_TEST to select only, so the declared profiles.owner.update cell was never executed.
findings.appliedTo: Supabase DIM-staging, 2026-09-02, by the PO. The only live database; the old DIM project is INACTIVE.

findings.fix: Forward migration redefining pii.caller_is_admin with AND deleted_at IS NULL (copy 0188:56-60); add an erased-admin case asserting 42501.

findings.title: pet_events PostgREST INSERT admits forged provenance (author_role / author_verified), permanently, in the append-only spine
findings.fix: DECIDED 2026-09-02 (PO, engram topic sdd/audit-2026-09/decisions): queued as migration 0212 in the next batch, same shape as 0211 - lock the PostgREST write path, since /api/v1 and the use cases are the only legitimate writers. Ship with pnpm facts:write and an RLS fence test; remote apply is PO-gated and staging-only. NOT YET WRITTEN: db/migrations/0212* does not exist at this snapshot; recount the next free NNNN at write time.

findings.title: An UNCONFIRMED e-mail address is accepted as the addressee proof that moves titularidad and grants caretaker access
findings.fix: Gate the e-mail fallback arm on the accepting account's email_confirmed_at being non-null, or bind the invitation to a single-use secret delivered to the address.

findings.title: A self-deactivated PERSONAL account (owner/vet) is never locked out at any boundary
findings.fix: Decide the personal-deactivation policy in requireLiveUser: widen the predicate to every accountType and build the deactivated-account landing screen, or make the use case refuse until it exists.

findings.title: The subject-rights coverage fence cannot express one-sided coverage — a table reached by ONE RPC is counted as covered
findings.fix: Split into a per-table {export, erase} classification, each side covered | exempt(reason) | gap(reason), failing on any unclassified side; move attachments out of EXEMPT.

findings.title: expire_decomiso_handoffs hands budgetHeaders to runCaseCron's UNBATCHED branch, which never reads a clock; the ceiling fence text-matches the dead input as budget-honouring
findings.fix: Give the route a batchSize (keyset on the raw scan id) or make the unbatched branch honour budgetHeaders; then tighten READS_THE_BUDGET so budgetHeaders without batchSize no longer reads as honoursBudget.

findings.title: pet-photos is a PUBLIC bucket with an unscoped authenticated INSERT and no bucket-level MIME or size ceiling
findings.fix: One forward migration setting file_size_limit = 5242880 and allowed_mime_types on pet-photos, mirroring 0206; repeat for event-attachments, avatars, org-logos.

findings.title: /perdidas and /sitemap.xml spend no rate-limit bucket at all — the bulk lost-pet feed hands out tokens with no per-IP budget
findings.fix: callerIp(await headers()) + enforceRateLimit("lost_listing", ip, ...) at the top of the page with a soft-fail notice, and the same for app/sitemap.ts. The limit value is a PO call.

findings.title: sitemap.ts passes pageSize 5000, inflating the internal fetch cap to 25,000 and turning an O(n^2) id filter into hundreds of millions of comparisons — unthrottled, no deadline
findings.fix: Replace the Array.includes filter with a Set; decouple the fetch cap from pageSize for bulk callers; wrap the Promise.all in loadWithTimeout.

findings.title: app/sitemap.ts runs an unthrottled, unbudgeted 3-way DB fan-out on every anonymous request, one query completely unbounded
findings.fix: Wrap the three reads in loadWithTimeout, .limit() the organizations select, give the route a revalidate window or a per-IP bucket, and add it to check-db-budget.ts's DASHBOARD_PAGES.

findings.title: SITEMAP_PAGE_SIZE 5000 silently becomes a 25,000-row scan; the comment claiming the queries are already bounded is false for the lost feed
findings.fix: Pass the fourth argument the function already exposes, or drop the constant to a defensible number, and correct the :32-33 comment.

findings.title: Two anonymous token-resolving routes carry no per-IP budget at all: /refugios/[orgToken] and /r/invite/[token]
findings.fix: Give each its own literal bucket before the first DB read, then widen the throttle-coverage census beyond DIM-token resolvers.

findings.title: Anonymous write actions are keyed (endpoint:token, ip) only — no IP-less per-token global cap
findings.fix: Add a second, IP-less bucket keyed on the token alone alongside the per-(token,ip) one in all three call sites, as submit-org-contact.ts already does.

findings.title: no-store allowlist has drifted from the force-dynamic public set (/t/[serial], /refugios*), and its fence asserts the drift is correct
findings.fix: Derive the fence from the tree with an explicit exemption map, then add /t/ and /refugios to NO_STORE_PREFIXES (or move the refugios pages off force-dynamic).

findings.title: robots.txt Disallow: /r blocks the entire public shelter directory the sitemap advertises (prefix match, not segment match)
findings.fix: Change "/r" to "/r/" and "/t" to "/t/", then add a test cross-checking every URL shape app/sitemap.ts emits against the disallow array.

findings.title: The anon-callable custody-dispute gate that blocks relaying a finder's name and phone to a contested owner has no server-side test
findings.fix: One negative case per action asserting ok:false, the DISPUTE_TIP_NOTICE error, and that createNotificationsBulk was NOT called.

findings.title: A client-asserted province/locality clears the "Jurisdiccion sin verificar" badge with no cross-check against the coordinates in the same body
findings.fix: Cross-check the pair against locationLat/Lng and fall back to unverified:true on disagreement, or make resolve_location return a signed candidate handle.

findings.title: Mobile Sentry ships to a third party with no beforeSend or beforeBreadcrumb; the project's scrubber is web-only
findings.fix: Add beforeSend running message/exception text through the web's redactText rules and beforeBreadcrumb stripping query strings from http breadcrumbs; pin both in sentry.test.ts.

findings.title: Test-only rate-limit reset helpers are exported from "use server" modules, so they are production server actions that disarm live throttles
findings.fix: Move both resets into the plain rate-limit module; add a fence rule banning __*ForTests / __reset* exports from "use server" files.

findings.title: alert_subscriptions RLS admin branch fails open for an art.16-erased admin (checks deactivated_at, never deleted_at)
findings.fix: Forward migration adding AND p.deleted_at IS NULL to the admin EXISTS branch, matching 0188; add an erased-admin principal to __tests__/rls.

findings.title: The fleet alert sweep selects subscription owners with no liveness join — an erased or deactivated admin's rules keep firing
findings.fix: Join profiles in the owner sweep requiring role='admin' AND deactivated_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL, or have erase/deactivate set is_active=false on the subject's subscriptions.

findings.title: The dead-letter drain replays un-redacted payloads into public.notifications, silently undoing an art. 16 erasure the same table already had applied
findings.fix: Resolve or null the subject's dead-letter rows in the same transaction as erase_subject_data; skip replay when the recipient profile has deleted_at set.

findings.title: notification_dead_letter.payload stores a third party's name and phone/e-mail verbatim, forever, and no erasure or lifecycle job ever reaches it
findings.fix: On resolve, null the payload (keep dedupe_key, error_message and timestamps), or add a retention sweep to data-lifecycle.

findings.title: Art. 16 erasure removes three buckets and leaves the subject's avatar photograph in storage
findings.fix: Add an avatars/{userId}/ prefix sweep reusing the paginated loop; decide and document whether welfare-evidence and revocations are retention or gap; extend the coverage fence with a bucket inventory.

findings.title: Org transitos historial lists foster rows the org was never party to
findings.fix: Bind the historial foster rows to the viewing org the way the activos tab is bound — innerJoin fosterProposals with eq(fosterProposals.organizationId, organization.id).

findings.title: Govt proposal writes a client-supplied jurisdiction with no assignment check
findings.fix: Load the actor's active govt_assignments in admin-proposals/helpers.ts and reject unless jurisdictionScopeContains matches; route the pair through resolveCanonicalJurisdiction.

findings.title: fetchQueueHealthScoped([]) returns NATIONAL approval-queue counts for a govt with zero active jurisdictions
findings.fix: Give the helper the role its siblings take: return zeroed for a govt with an empty jurisdiction list before any query — empty means universal only for admin.

findings.title: evaluateAlertSubscriptions derives a govt actor's scope from the subscription row, not the caller — and the in-file comment claims the opposite
findings.fix: For a non-admin baseActor, intersect the subscription's pair with the caller's own jurisdictions before evaluation; correct the comment; add a govt-actor test.

findings.title: updateWeightProjection re-derives pets.estimatedWeightKg from RAW events and silently reverts an amended weight
findings.fix: Fetch event_amended alongside the weight-bearing types and run overlayAmendments before replayPetWeight; add a db test that amends then back-dates.

findings.title: rederivePregnancyStatus replays RAW clinical_info_logged and reverts an amended pregnancy outcome
findings.fix: Include event_amended in the WHERE and overlay before replayPetPregnancy — two lines, matching the sibling that already overlays the identical stream.

findings.title: Production drift detection covers 2 of the ~23-26 cache columns rederivePetCache computes; the script that covers the rest is wired to nothing
findings.fix: Widen STATUS_FAMILY to the full report with per-family severity, or schedule scripts/detect-pet-cache-drift.ts as a job beside db-doctor-staging.yml.

findings.title: Nothing enumerates pets columns against the rederive checked/excluded lists — the exact silence that hid jurisdiction and the condition columns
findings.fix: Offline fitness test doing getTableColumns(pets), asserting every column is either returned by a replay* projection or a member of an exported EXCLUDED_CACHE_COLUMNS.

findings.title: No fence ties AMENDABLE_EVENT_TYPES to the raw-replay call sites; the fold is enforced only by reviewer memory
findings.fix: New scripts/check-amendment-overlay.ts enumerating every module importing a replayPet* or selecting petEvents.payload for an amendable type, requiring overlayAmendments or a reasoned allowlist entry.

findings.title: Business-rule locality is trim-only, so a non-catalog spelling makes the rule inert while the console renders it as configured
findings.fix: Run (province, locality) through resolveCanonicalJurisdiction inside normalizeJurisdiction and reject an unresolvable pair before create/update.

findings.title: Locality-integrity fitness sweep covers govt_assignments but never pets
findings.fix: Sibling db-project test asserting every active pets row's non-null (province, locality) resolves against ar_localities, plus a forward repair migration mirroring 0117 for pets.

findings.title: The P2P transfer accept ends caretaker arrangements and then drops the notification fan-out its own repository returns for that purpose
findings.fix: Destructure { endedCaretakerGrants }, pass { actorUserId, now }, and call notifyCaretakersOfHandoff after commit as finalize-adoption.ts does; update the two-argument assertion in the same change.

findings.title: The pet_events override's accountability clause is enforced but untested — case_events tests it, the more important table does not

findings.title: updatePasswordAction accepts ANY live session, not a recovery session — password change with no current-password proof
findings.fix: Require proof of the recovery flow (AAL/amr) or of the current password; set secure_password_change = true locally and on the hosted project; correct the file header.

findings.title: Personal-account self-deactivation locks nobody out, and the dialog comment claims a guard that does not exist for it
findings.fix: Correct the DeactivateAccountDialog comment now; then either widen the guard once a landing screen exists, or have the use case call a global admin sign-out.

findings.title: Recovery OTP is 6 digits valid for a full hour, and code redemption has no app-level budget

findings.title: GoTrue password floor (6 chars, no complexity) is weaker than the app's 8, and the app check is bypassable via the public anon key
findings.fix: Set minimum_password_length = 8 and password_requirements, and match on the hosted project's Auth settings.

findings.title: logoutAction discards signOut's error — the exact auth-js failure /turno-vencido and the mobile client handle terminally
findings.fix: Bind the result in both functions and stop redirecting on failure, mirroring turno-vencido/route.ts:133; if a redirect must happen, delete sb-* cookies explicitly first.

findings.title: The EAS production profile declares no env, so a store build points its data plane at staging

findings.title: event-attachments has a second write door that performs no content validation at all

findings.title: isMetadataStripped's docblock claims to be the live GPS gate and to fail closed; it has zero callers and would fail OPEN
findings.fix: Rewrite the docblock to say it guards no live surface (or delete the export), or make it answer from a persisted boolean rather than the client-declared mime.

findings.title: Three ceiling-EXEMPT daily jobs reserve 0 ms and bound themselves by ROWS, not by clock — close_rabies_observations can sweep 500 pets starting at 54.9 s of a 55 s budget

findings.title: refresh_cube is the only registered job that pages nobody on failure, and its client construction sits outside the try so a throw strands the cron_runs row at 'running'

findings.title: db/rls.sql is a maintained-looking decoy: pasting it re-opens two policies migrations 0175 and 0115 closed

findings.title: search_path pinning is fenced by a 6-name hand list, in the same file whose sibling rule was upgraded to catalog enumeration precisely because lists miss things

findings.title: check-authz-guards accepts a bare auth.getUser() as a guard, and its deletion-aware backstop only looks at pets/petEvents

findings.title: Nothing keeps the erasure's free-text payload key list in sync with the event schemas — a new free-text key escapes art. 16 silently

findings.title: Migration 0208's header claims organization_memberships is already in both RPCs since 0059 — it has never been in erase_subject_data
findings.fix: Add the correction to the existing ERRATA block in erase-subject-data.ts:20-55, stating the table is export-only and that closing it is an open art. 16 item.

findings.fix: Spend API_V1_AUTHENTICATED_READ_USER_LIMIT on api_v1_adoptions_read_user immediately after requireLiveUser, in the shape the sibling catalogue route uses.

findings.title: GET /api/v1/pets/{publicToken} is the only one of 33 v1 routes whose handler no test imports

findings.title: The only dispute SLA is a 365-day warning notification with no consequence and no first-response deadline
findings.fix: Add a 30/60-day first-response SLA addressed to the assigned arbiter, distinct from the 365-day stale flag; surface days-open on the dispute queue.

findings.title: vet_name / administered_by professional-name snapshots are never anonymized when that professional erases their own account

findings.title: check-authz-scoping is a report-only ratchet: 44 tolerated offenders across 19 files, and it never shrinks on its own
findings.fix: Pick a burn-down owner and date, or convert the ratchet to also fail on the sum so the total can only go down.

findings.title: Leaked-password protection still off on the hosted project

findings.title: searchUsers still defaults its scope to universal-admin PII search

findings.title: Ownership drift detection covers only the caretaker role — owner, foster and shelter_custody rows have none

findings.title: lib/projections/** still does not self-overlay amendments — correctness still depends on every caller remembering

findings.title: scan_event_purged audit rows are written with actor_user_id = null — the one audited mutation path with no actor

findings.title: tag_resolve is the only public read bucket with a single window (per-minute, no hourly cap)
findings.refutedReason: The uniqueness premise is false: search-localities.ts:27 is a single-window maxPerMinute:60 bucket spent by an anonymous action keyed on one shared sentinel — weaker than tag_resolve's per-IP key. The convention the finding asserts does not exist, so nothing is an exception to it.

findings.title: The erasure predicate on the lost listing and its two KPI counts has no test
findings.refutedReason: 3/3 refuted. The finder grepped for the reader's function names and concluded absence; the guard addresses the file by PATH inside a derived static sweep in __tests__/public-soft-delete-resolution.test.ts:1376-1420, where the file is a named non-vacuity anchor and absent from the debt map. All three refuters hand-counted 3 reads against 3 guards; deleting one fails the sweep.

findings.title: config.toml auth settings still have no push or parity step to the hosted project
findings.refutedReason: The finding's own evidenceCmd does not reproduce: docs/ops/env-handling.md:145-150 states the hosted equivalent is set manually as a PO-gated step and carries a parity table pairing each local value with its dashboard location; the prelaunch checklist carries a line to verify hosted Auth rate limits. The parity step the finding says is absent exists for exactly the values it names.

findings.title: incident_reported.injuries_summary — free prose about a bite victim — survives erasure while victim_contact_name/phone are deleted
findings.refutedReason: 2 of 3 refute. The physical fact holds, but the load-bearing claim (that the omission is an oversight) is contradicted by 0129:31 and :107, which state twice under a SCOPE heading that only the two contact keys are removed; a test pins the residue green today. This is a documented retention decision to re-open with the PO, same class as A05-6 — not an unnoticed defect.

findings.title: Tier-2 libreta share re-renders vet-authored event notes verbatim to any holder of the share link
findings.refutedReason: All three refuters agree the code facts hold but refute the framing: the owner already sees the same note text on their own authenticated pages, so the premise that an owner cannot know what a vet wrote is false. The row is not a raw dump either — four clauses apply before render. Consensus: a copy/UX suggestion, not a security boundary failure.

findings.title: pet_events FKs declare ON DELETE SET NULL, a promise the append-only trigger can never keep, and a live profiles DELETE runs into it
findings.refutedReason: 3/3 refuted, high confidence: claim-stub-profile.ts:36 sets STUB_CLAIM_ENABLED = false and lines 61-67 return an explanatory error before any DB call, so the delete is unreachable dead code held pending Mi Argentina identity verification. No other delete(profiles) call site exists outside tests. The schema-declaration mismatch is real but latent, filed as a nit.

findings.title: Strict locality mode passes raw text through when the province fails to resolve
findings.refutedReason: The code lines reproduce but the trigger is false: canonicalProvinceNameForStorage DOES resolve "caba" — ar-provincias.ts:98-112 normalizes (trim, casefold, strip diacritics, drop dots) against an all-lowercase alias map, with the docblock listing that exact case. The finder's scenario never reaches the passthrough branch; the residual class is stopped by the 0055 CHECK the finding itself cites.

findings.title: jurisdictionLocality accepted with no province/locality integrity check
findings.refutedReason: The schema gap is real, but the only component calling createAlertSubscriptionAction renders no locality input at all, so the action always resolves the field to null. Producing the described mismatched pair requires a hand-forged POST, not the plausible typo the exploit narrative assumes — at most a latent defensive gap should a locality field ever be added.

findings.title: The fleet's auth tripwire excludes the dispatcher, so /api/cron/daily is the single cron route whose secret gate no fence covers
findings.refutedReason: The narrow fact reproduces but the headline is false: scripts/check-authz-guards.ts discovers app/**/route.ts and flags any exported async handler calling none of ROUTE_HANDLER_GUARDS, a set that unions SYSTEM_GUARDS (authorizeCronRequest, checkCronSecret). It runs as lint:authz inside pnpm verify, so deleting the guard from daily/route.ts turns verify RED.

findings.title: deploy:staging's migration step targets the LOCAL database
findings.refutedReason: The dotenv facts reproduce, but dotenv does not override an already-set variable, and the documented invocation (docs/ops/staging-deploy.md:16-22) sets DATABASE_URL to the staging pooler before running the script. The finder also mis-timed the mitigation: the destination banner prints when migrate.ts starts, after the ~20-minute verify, so it is the freshest thing on screen.

findings.title: Password-reset e-mail builds its redirect with ??, the exact empty-string trap lib/infra/site-url.ts exists to cure
findings.refutedReason: The code diff reproduces but the failure is prevented everywhere it would matter: lib/infra/env.ts:49-53 classifies staging and production both as real prod, :70-75 then requires NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL via .min(1).url(), and instrumentation.ts imports the module in register(), so validation throws at boot. The stated escape hatch describes a deploy that cannot reach its database at all.
